narrative: This chapter reframes patience as the phenomenological inside view of what randomness plus selective memory produces over time — the ratchet that keeps almost all gains while losing almost none permanently. Moving from Leo Spiegel's CEO boulder-rolling through evolutionary biology to Whitehead's lure and Teilhard's Omega Point, it argues that the universe's filter is precisely patient: it accepts only what holds, waits as long as needed, and accumulates structures capable of reflection — culminating in the claim that love is what patience builds toward when reflectors complex enough to notice meet each other.
